events.verdict: Herro (MIA) jumps alongside Carter Jr. (ORL) and marginal arm contact occurs during Carter Jr.'s upward shooting motion.
Adebayo (MIA) is firming up when he makes marginal contact with Suggs (ORL) while setting the pick on the perimeter.
da Silva (ORL) establishes himself in Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) path prior to the marginal contact during the pick.
Bane (ORL) initiates contact with Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Larsson (MIA) makes marginal contact without extending his arm into da Silva's (ORL) side while he brings the ball up in transition.
da Silva (ORL) does not establish positive frontcourt position with both feet and the ball before he briefly returns to the backcourt before crossing into the frontcourt.
da Silva (ORL) establishes the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Bane (ORL) initiates illegal contact with Larsson's (MIA) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
